C0147.title: Account Reseller Gang Busted: Weifang Gaomi Police Crack Cross-Provincial Personal Information Infringement Case
C0147.summary: In January 2026, police in Gaomi, Weifang, Shandong, dismantled a cross-provincial criminal operation involving the infringement of citizens' personal information, arresting 16 suspects led by Wang. The group illegally obtained real-name authenticated online accounts through upstream 'account resellers' and 'ground promoters', then sold or rented them for profit.
